question: What division of knowledge does the speaker seek to know fully and endlessly?
premises: A division consisting of eight octads is named.
The speaker seeks to know this division fully.
The knowing is desired without end.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight octads is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And I seek to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
